model_annotation: This chart presents two side-by-side grouped bar charts illustrating percentage values for three metals—Aluminium, Kupfer (Copper), and Nickel—across three years (2021, 2022, and 2023), with the left panel labeled "Deutschland" (Germany) and the right panel labeled "EU." In both panels, the horizontal axis displays the three metal categories (Aluminium, Kupfer, Nickel), while the vertical axis represents percentage values labeled with a "%" symbol, ranging from 0 to 30 with tick intervals of 5. Each metal category contains a group of three bars: blue for 2021, dark purple/magenta for 2022, and gray for 2023, as indicated by the shared legend at the bottom of the chart. In the Deutschland panel, the Aluminium group shows values of 3.6% (blue), 2.7% (purple), and 1.0% (gray); the Kupfer group shows 8.3% (blue), 11.3% (purple), and 2.2% (gray); and the Nickel group shows 25.1% (blue), 24.7% (purple), and 11.4% (gray). In the EU panel, the Aluminium group shows values of 3.2% (blue), 2.8% (purple), and 1.7% (gray); the Kupfer group shows 4.4% (blue), 5.1% (purple), and 1.3% (gray); and the Nickel group shows 24.3% (blue), 23.3% (purple), and 14.6% (gray). All bars are annotated with their exact values displayed above each bar. Within each panel, the tallest bars appear in the Nickel category, with the 2021 blue bar reaching the highest value in both panels (25.1% for Deutschland and 24.3% for EU), while the shortest bars appear in the Aluminium category, with the 2023 gray bar being the smallest (1.0% for Deutschland and 1.3% for the EU's Kupfer group). The bars within each group are arranged in chronological order from left to right (2021, 2022, 2023), and the metal categories are ordered identically across both panels as Aluminium, Kupfer, and Nickel.
